mandatoryFindings.title: Current control can self-complete or omit its writer
mandatoryFindings.establishedBehavior: The current setup-control fixture originally includes writer900102 with self-evidence and actualStatus:null. Keeping that row but setting actualStatus0, or omitting it entirely, both permit actual A.run negative to write the client journal and MISSING_READINESS/status1 denial with an empty completion-attestation actor list. mandatoryFindings.impact: Exact pending-set matching covers only rows supplied by the control. It does not establish a designated current writer or enforce that the immutable control cannot claim its own future completion. A falsely complete/omitted writer can evade required external completion and future numeric accounting. No real writer or completion was observed.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Require an exact source-bound designated author for every setup/prior/current control, with actual known PID/parent/evidence binding and pending completion in its own immutable record. Reject omitted, wrong-source or precompleted current-author rows; resolve only from the independently supplied post-completion attestation. Preserve every old control and accumulated pending author, historical failure/tool-status distinctions and actual dynamic union; do not coerce old failed actors into success.

Omitted current author or self-declared actualStatus0 rejects even when the empty observed set matches the supplied rows.
